question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for Wireless Communication without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor, use formal R&S specifications/features documents plus competitor official datasheets or third-party evidence, not R&S internal battle cards alone.[18][24][27]
### Evidence required
| Claim type | Required evidence | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R&S product capability | Use CMX500 formal specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 for CMX500 claims.[3] | The CMX500 page states that formal specifications provide binding specifications, while the features document is only a features/functions overview and not a technical specifications datasheet.[3] |
| Binding technical specification | Use data with tolerance limits and stated specification conditions.[3] | CMX500 specifications distinguish binding specifications from typical, nominal, measured and non-traceable data, and the non-binding data is not warranted by Rohde & Schwarz.[3] |
| Feature-level claim | Use the CMX500 Features and Functions document only for software features, signaling/application/measurement options and user-interface claims.[3] | The CMX500 Features and Functions source is expressly a features/functions overview and says data without tolerance limits is not binding.[3] |
| Signaling capability | Cite the specific CMX500 signaling options, such as WLAN signaling options and NR/LTE signaling options, when making signaling claims.[62][64] | The CMX500 signaling tables list option codes, names, order numbers and dependency/limitation notes for WLAN, LTE, NR, RedCap, eRedCap and NTN signaling options.[62][64] |
| Wireless technology coverage | Cite CMX500 sources for supported technologies such as LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN, NB-IoT, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement.[1][46] | The CMX500 sources state these wireless technologies and test topics as supported feature areas.[1][46] |
| Non-signaling use case | Cite the CMX500 Callbox source only as a use-case source for non-signaling verification.[77] | The CMX500 Callbox source lists “Non-signaling verification” as an example callbox use case.[77] |
| Production / non-signaling tester claim | Cite CMP180 product sources if the comparison includes production or wireless communication device testing.[34][35] | CMP180 is described as a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing, with configurable RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability.[34][35] |
| Competitor capability | Obtain competitor official datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions before making competitor claims.[19][31][43][44] | The Keysight and Anritsu pages state that R&S battle cards lack competitor official datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes or complete test conditions.[19][31][43][44] |
| Customer-facing competitor comparison | Use competitor official sources and third-party evidence in addition to any R&S internal battle card.[18][24][27] | The Keysight, Anritsu and amarisoft comparison pages state that R&S internal battle-card claims need competitor official data and third-party evidence for customer documents.[18][24][27] |
| Architecture or “one platform” claims | Verify platform architecture, option stack and configuration with formal R&S documents and competitor official documents before using the claim.[17][18][23][24] | The comparison tables say battle cards did not provide official competitor data and that R&S one-platform or option claims require formal option verification.[17][18][23][24] |
| Performance numbers | Require formal datasheets or reports with test conditions, carrier/band combinations, bandwidth, modulation, MIMO layers and tolerance where relevant.[19] | The RFU18 / bandwidth battle-card claims lack test conditions, band combination, carrier count, SCS, modulation, MIMO layers and binding tolerance.[19] |
| Conformance leadership or validation claim | Require validation reports, test-case lists, PTCRB RFT versions and dates before using claims such as first validated NTN conformance.[19][86] | The Keysight comparison sources say the NTN validation claim lacks a validation report, PTCRB RFT 555 version and test-case list.[19][86] |
| TCO, fewer boxes or leadership claim | Do not present “only platform,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO” or “fewer boxes” as technical facts unless formal evidence exists.[18][19][24][27][94] | The comparison pages identify these expressions as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications.[18][19][24][27][94] |
| Roadmap / RFU18 / FR3 claim | Treat RFU18 / FR3 claims as roadmap or comparison-table wording unless formal datasheets, release notes or product documentation are available.[49][50][53] | The RFU18 pages state that the RFU8 vs RFU18 comparison is a lossy derivative, not a formal RFU18 datasheet, and that FR3 wording lacks normative definition and test conditions.[49][50][53] |
| Beta feature claim | State beta limitations when citing RFU18 beta information.[52] | The RFU18 page states beta availability, GA plan, current beta signaling support of NR FR1 and LTE only, and that NR FR2 / WiFi / NB-IoT are out of scope for beta.[52] |
| Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester claim | Use the Anritsu brochure only to describe Anritsu MX844030PC / MD8190A / Virtual Signalling Tester, not to prove R&S advantages.[13][24] | The Anritsu comparison page says the Anritsu brochure can describe Anritsu products but cannot verify R&S superiority claims.[24] |
| Virtual Signalling Tester coverage | Require a full test-case list, scenario library, 3GPP release coverage, conformance status and throughput metrics before comparing virtual signaling coverage.[84] | The Virtual Signalling Tester page says those items are not provided by the source.[84] |
### Unsupported without more evidence
A direct technical comparison against Keysight, Anritsu or amarisoft is not fully supported by the current passages because the competitor claims are mainly from R&S internal battle cards and require competitor official data or third-party evidence.[18][24][27]
A customer-facing claim that our solution has lower TCO, fewer boxes, better leadership or an “only platform” advantage is not supported as a technical specification by the cited comparison sources.[18][19][24][94]

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › 文件依據與版次
本頁並列使用兩份來源：

| 來源 | 文件類型 | 文件編號 | 版次 / 軟體 | 日期 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] | Specifications | PD 5216.4127.22 | Version 11.00 | August 2025 | binding specifications、hardware unit 型號、order number、環境、尺寸、電源、service |
| [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] | Features and Functions | 1179.1164.02 | Version 32；CSW 9.20.0 and higher | 來源未標示；© 2026 | GUI、software features、signaling / application / measurement options 與使用介面 |

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMW270 › 文件與適用範圍
- 來源：[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]。
- 文件編號：PD 5213.9211.22。
- 文件版次：Version 17.00。
- 文件日期：April 2023。
- 文件名稱：R&S®CMW Wideband Radio Communication Tester。
- 規格適用於 [[R&S CMW270]] 搭配 40/80 MHz bandwidth unit：R&S®CMW-H570A/B、R&S®CMW-H100A/D；以及 160 MHz bandwidth unit：R&S®CMW-H570H、R&S®CMW-H100H，除非原文另有說明。

R&S CMW270 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

R&S CMW270 › 訂購資訊
| 項目 | Type | Order No. | 原文說明 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Wireless connectivity tester | R&S®CMW270 | 1201.0002K75 | 來源列於 ordering information |

來源指出更多 available options 的 ordering information 需參考 product brochure PD 5214.2833.12 或 local Rohde & Schwarz expert；本 data sheet 未列完整 option order no.。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Post-silicon testing
- 適用 [[IoT]] device 與 communication module 的 basic protocol test。
- 支援快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。
- 來源列出 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用語境。

Virtual Signalling Tester
[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu 對 virtualized protocol stack test solution 的產品 / 解決方案語彙，核心是用 PC-based software protocol simulator 建立 NR / RedCap protocol test environment。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |
| FR1 / FR2 | quick table 寫 FR1 up to 18 GHz、FR2 up to 50 GHz (RRH evo) | E7515P up to 15 GHz；FR2 split 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz | R&S FR1 up to 18 GHz 與正式規格口徑衝突，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 使用限制
- 本頁不可取代 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMW500]] 或 Keysight UXM 各型號的正式 specifications / features documents。
- 對 [[Keysight]] 的主張目前只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源；若用於客戶文件，應另查 Keysight 官方資料與第三方證據。
- only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO、fewer boxes 等語句是 sales language，不應當作可驗證技術規格。
- RFU18、FR3、2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth、AI Script Assistant、Keysight RaySim / Atlas / Channel Studio 的正式功能邊界與版本仍需補來源。

- unresolved：來源標示 COMPANY CONFIDENTIAL；未說明可對外使用範圍。
- unresolved：來源未提供 [[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] 的正式文件編號、版本、order number 或日期。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor, use formal R&S specifications/features documents plus competitor official datasheets or third-party evidence, not R&S internal battle cards alone.[18][24][27]
### Evidence required
| Claim type | Required evidence | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R&S product capability | Use CMX500 formal specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 for CMX500 claims.[3] | The CMX500 page states that formal specifications provide binding specifications, while the features document is only a features/functions overview and not a technical specifications datasheet.[3] |
| Binding technical specification | Use data with tolerance limits and stated specification conditions.[3] | CMX500 specifications distinguish binding specifications from typical, nominal, measured and non-traceable data, and the non-binding data is not warranted by Rohde & Schwarz.[3] |
| Feature-level claim | Use the CMX500 Features and Functions document only for software features, signaling/application/measurement options and user-interface claims.[3] | The CMX500 Features and Functions source is expressly a features/functions overview and says data without tolerance limits is not binding.[3] |
| Signaling capability | Cite the specific CMX500 signaling options, such as WLAN signaling options and NR/LTE signaling options, when making signaling claims.[62][64] | The CMX500 signaling tables list option codes, names, order numbers and dependency/limitation notes for WLAN, LTE, NR, RedCap, eRedCap and NTN signaling options.[62][64] |
| Wireless technology coverage | Cite CMX500 sources for supported technologies such as LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN, NB-IoT, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement.[1][46] | The CMX500 sources state these wireless technologies and test topics as supported feature areas.[1][46] |
| Non-signaling use case | Cite the CMX500 Callbox source only as a use-case source for non-signaling verification.[77] | The CMX500 Callbox source lists “Non-signaling verification” as an example callbox use case.[77] |
| Production / non-signaling tester claim | Cite CMP180 product sources if the comparison includes production or wireless communication device testing.[34][35] | CMP180 is described as a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing, with configurable RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability.[34][35] |

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 的 product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘；符合指定 environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。文件區分 specifications with limits、non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 與 uncertainties；non-traceable specifications、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擔保。

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 明示：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding**。它是 features/functions overview，不是 technical specifications datasheet。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。

- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

- 支援快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。
- 來源列出 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用語境。

Virtual Signalling Tester
[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu 對 virtualized protocol stack test solution 的產品 / 解決方案語彙，核心是用 PC-based software protocol simulator 建立 NR / RedCap protocol test environment。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a Wireless Communication competitor, use formal R&S specifications/features documents plus competitor official datasheets or third-party evidence, not R&S internal battle cards alone.[18][24][27]
### Evidence required
| Claim type | Required evidence | Why |
|---|---|---|
| R&S product capability | Use CMX500 formal specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 for CMX500 claims.[3] | The CMX500 page states that formal specifications provide binding specifications, while the features document is only a features/functions overview and not a technical specifications datasheet.[3] |
| Binding technical specification | Use data with tolerance limits and stated specification conditions.[3] | CMX500 specifications distinguish binding specifications from typical, nominal, measured and non-traceable data, and the non-binding data is not warranted by Rohde & Schwarz.[3] |
| Feature-level claim | Use the CMX500 Features and Functions document only for software features, signaling/application/measurement options and user-interface claims.[3] | The CMX500 Features and Functions source is expressly a features/functions overview and says data without tolerance limits is not binding.[3] |
| Signaling capability | Cite the specific CMX500 signaling options, such as WLAN signaling options and NR/LTE signaling options, when making signaling claims.[62][64] | The CMX500 signaling tables list option codes, names, order numbers and dependency/limitation notes for WLAN, LTE, NR, RedCap, eRedCap and NTN signaling options.[62][64] |
| Wireless technology coverage | Cite CMX500 sources for supported technologies such as LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN, NB-IoT, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement.[1][46] | The CMX500 sources state these wireless technologies and test topics as supported feature areas.[1][46] |
| Non-signaling use case | Cite the CMX500 Callbox source only as a use-case source for non-signaling verification.[77] | The CMX500 Callbox source lists “Non-signaling verification” as an example callbox use case.[77] |
| Production / non-signaling tester claim | Cite CMP180 product sources if the comparison includes production or wireless communication device testing.[34][35] | CMP180 is described as a Radio Communication Tester for production / wireless communication device testing, with configurable RF generator/analyzer, communication-standard measurement options, waveform options and R&S VSE analysis capability.[34][35] |
| Competitor capability | Obtain competitor official datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions before making competitor claims.[19][31][43][44] | The Keysight and Anritsu pages state that R&S battle cards lack competitor official datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes or complete test conditions.[19][31][43][44] |
| Customer-facing competitor comparison | Use competitor official sources and third-party evidence in addition to any R&S internal battle card.[18][24][27] | The Keysight, Anritsu and amarisoft comparison pages state that R&S internal battle-card claims need competitor official data and third-party evidence for customer documents.[18][24][27] |
| Architecture or “one platform” claims | Verify platform architecture, option stack and configuration with formal R&S documents and competitor official documents before using the claim.[17][18][23][24] | The comparison tables say battle cards did not provide official competitor data and that R&S one-platform or option claims require formal option verification.[17][18][23][24] |
| Performance numbers | Require formal datasheets or reports with test conditions, carrier/band combinations, bandwidth, modulation, MIMO layers and tolerance where relevant.[19] | The RFU18 / bandwidth battle-card claims lack test conditions, band combination, carrier count, SCS, modulation, MIMO layers and binding tolerance.[19] |
| Conformance leadership or validation claim | Require validation reports, test-case lists, PTCRB RFT versions and dates before using claims such as first validated NTN conformance.[19][86] | The Keysight comparison sources say the NTN validation claim lacks a validation report, PTCRB RFT 555 version and test-case list.[19][86] |
| TCO, fewer boxes or leadership claim | Do not present “only platform,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO” or “fewer boxes” as technical facts unless formal evidence exists.[18][19][24][27][94] | The comparison pages identify these expressions as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications.[18][19][24][27][94] |
| Roadmap / RFU18 / FR3 claim | Treat RFU18 / FR3 claims as roadmap or comparison-table wording unless formal datasheets, release notes or product documentation are available.[49][50][53] | The RFU18 pages state that the RFU8 vs RFU18 comparison is a lossy derivative, not a formal RFU18 datasheet, and that FR3 wording lacks normative definition and test conditions.[49][50][53] |
| Beta feature claim | State beta limitations when citing RFU18 beta information.[52] | The RFU18 page states beta availability, GA plan, current beta signaling support of NR FR1 and LTE only, and that NR FR2 / WiFi / NB-IoT are out of scope for beta.[52] |
| Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester claim | Use the Anritsu brochure only to describe Anritsu MX844030PC / MD8190A / Virtual Signalling Tester, not to prove R&S advantages.[13][24] | The Anritsu comparison page says the Anritsu brochure can describe Anritsu products but cannot verify R&S superiority claims.[24] |
| Virtual Signalling Tester coverage | Require a full test-case list, scenario library, 3GPP release coverage, conformance status and throughput metrics before comparing virtual signaling coverage.[84] | The Virtual Signalling Tester page says those items are not provided by the source.[84] |
### Unsupported without more evidence
A direct technical comparison against Keysight, Anritsu or amarisoft is not fully supported by the current passages because the competitor claims are mainly from R&S internal battle cards and require competitor official data or third-party evidence.[18][24][27]
A customer-facing claim that our solution has lower TCO, fewer boxes, better leadership or an “only platform” advantage is not supported as a technical specification by the cited comparison sources.[18][19][24][94]
